masteryPolicy: System completion is user-asserted study progress. It is not a certification, credential, or proof of competency.

paths.title: Plant Foundations
paths.summary: Build a whole-plant model from seed establishment through roots, stems, branching, leaves, flowers, and trichomes.
paths.outcome: Connect major structures to their roles in the plant as one biological system.

paths.title: Water & Transport
paths.summary: Follow water and dissolved ions from the root zone through vascular transport, leaf exchange, and atmospheric demand.
paths.outcome: Explain how roots, xylem, stomata, transpiration, nutrition, and environment interact.

paths.title: Diagnostic Reasoning
paths.summary: Move from a healthy baseline to pattern description, measured context, stress biology, and differential diagnosis.
paths.outcome: Use observations and measurements to separate plausible explanations before acting.

paths.title: Canopy Architecture
paths.summary: Connect meristems, branching, vascular support, light capture, signaling, environment, and phenotype.
paths.outcome: Understand why canopy form emerges from genetics, signaling, structure, and environment together.

paths.title: Reproduction & Breeding Biology
paths.summary: Follow reproductive development through flower anatomy, sex expression, pollen, fertilization, seed, inheritance, and phenotype.
paths.outcome: Connect reproductive structures and processes with genetics and observable variation.

paths.title: Flower & Trichome Observation
paths.summary: Study flower development, secretory structures, stress context, reproductive biology, and evidence-based observation.
paths.outcome: Use floral and trichome observations as context without treating appearance as a direct chemistry measurement.
